The Splunk detection rule line is your model: it names the platform, the MITRE ATT&CK mapping and the reduction in false positives. Your current role and certifications also make your focus on detection engineering and incident response credible.

Your resume is unlikely to be the reason you don't get a callback. Add a little more about the purple-team exercises and alert enrichment, then focus on finding roles that match your work. The competition for each job and a referral can also matter.
